items.title: Camden Property Trust (CPT) Bought Back Shares, Is It Trading At A Discount?
items.summary: Camden Property Trust (CPT) has just wrapped up a sizable share repurchase effort, buying back 4,536,826 shares for US$352.13 million, including 474,660 shares between July and early November 2026. items.title: Forget Being a Landlord: These 3 REITs Pay You to Own Apartments
items.summary: Apartment REITs are legally required to hand most of their income straight to shareholders, but not all of them are equally safe bets right now. Three landlords are collecting rent checks while new construction dries up, and the differences between them could cost you real money.

items.title: Renters Are Staying Put. These 4 Apartment REITs Could Benefit
